title: Infrastructure Inspection Officer
location: Aberfeldie VIC (188 Holmes Rd), field based across Moonee Valley
content_text: Moonee Valley City Council careers board (Oracle), requisition 11304, read 15 Oct 2026 AEDT. Fixed term 12 month, part time 3 days per week, Band 5 from $85,114.74 pa pro rata plus 12% super. Field based programmed and reactive inspections of roads, footpaths, shared paths, drainage interfaces, bridges and traffic signs under the Road Management Plan; identify and record defects, determine maintenance responses, issue and monitor work orders, inspect civil construction, maintenance and reinstatement works against approved drawings, permits and Council standards, keep inspection records, photographs and asset data, prepare inspection and compliance reports, liaise with residents, contractors and utilities. Skills and experience: qualification in civil engineering, civil construction, infrastructure, asset management or related discipline, and/or relevant demonstrated experience; experience in infrastructure inspection, civil construction, maintenance, asset management or related field; understanding of municipal road and path assets and risk based inspection; ability to interpret drawings, specifications, permits and construction standards; experience with asset management systems, mobile inspection technology, mapping systems and digital record keeping; organisation; communication; current Victorian Driver Licence; White Card or ability to obtain. Apply through the online system with a response to the Key Selection Criteria per the Application Guide. Enquiries: Adam Meilak, Coordinator Infrastructure and Public Realm, AMeilak@mvcc.vic.gov.au, 03 9243 1049. Checks: criminal history, pre-employment medical, driver licence, references, right to work. Closes 11:00pm Friday 23 October 2026. Also syndicated on publicroles.com.au.
apply_instructions: Apply Now on the Moonee Valley careers board (requisition 11304) before 11:00pm Friday 23 October 2026, with resume, cover letter and a written response to the Key Selection Criteria following the Council Application Guide.
